description: This PHP file defines the base class 'SugarRestService' for RESTful web service interactions within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem. It manages registration of functions, handles request serving, and integrates with different response/input types by loading related classes dynamically. It also manages external dependencies for core REST implementations and logging.

classes.name: SugarRestService
classes.description: A base class for REST web services in SuiteCRM, handling registration of functions, dynamic response/input type handling, and integration with REST implementation classes.

methods.name: _getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the class name for the specified response or input type, defaulting to 'SugarRest' if not found.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the REST service with a specified URL, loading appropriate response and server classes based on request parameters.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Placeholder method for registering types; currently no implementation.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers a PHP function to be exposed as a REST endpoint along with its input and output specifications.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, generates and sends the appropriate response using the configured response class.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Placeholder for registering multiple functions, currently no implementation.

methods.name: getRegisteredImplClass
methods.description: Returns the name of the registered implementation class.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Registers an implementation class and creates its instances, preparing the server for handling requests.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets a fault/error object on the server for error handling.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns the server object responsible for handling requests.
